Visitor returns bare-string image replacement; mixed-case alt/src preserved (regression guard for issue #350)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitImage(ctx: unknown, src: unknown, alt: unknown, title: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return `[image: ${alt} -> ${src}]`;
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<img src=\"PhotoOne.JPG\" alt=\"Sunset Over Bay\">", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
